dataFlow.readPath: User Request → TemplateLoader.load() → TemplateServiceClient.getTemplate() → MCP Transport → RPC API /v2/activities/templates/{id} → list_templates() → Redis.get() [MISS] → list_all_templates() → SurrealDB.query('SELECT * FROM activity_template...') → Flat list parsing → sanitize_record() → Redis.setex(TTL=3600) → Return to client
dataFlow.writePath: Template Registration → MCP Transport → RPC API POST /v2/activities/templates → create_template() → create_template_record() → SurrealDB.create(activity_template:{variant_id}) → Redis.setex(TTL=3600) → create_metrics() → Redis.set(metrics, TTL=300)
dataFlow.cacheClearRecovery: Redis.flushdb() → [All cache keys deleted] → User requests template → Redis.get() [MISS] → SurrealDB.select() → Template loaded from persistent storage → Redis.setex() → Cache repopulated
dataFlow.recordIdSerialization: SurrealDB.query() → Result with RecordID objects → sanitize_record() → RecordID converted to strings → JSON serialization safe → FastAPI response

schemaMigration.before: SCHEMAFULL table with fields: id, name, category (dropped all RPC API fields)
schemaMigration.after: SCHEMALESS table accepting all fields: variant_id, activity_id, variant_name, task_steps, version, genealogy, etc.
schemaMigration.method: REMOVE TABLE + DEFINE TABLE SCHEMALESS + 5 indexes

recordIdHandling.solution: sanitize_record() function recursively converts RecordID to string format 'table:id'
usagePoints: All SurrealDB query results sanitized before return

persistenceGuarantee.readPattern: Cache-aside (Redis hit → fast, Redis miss → SurrealDB fallback → cache repopulation)
persistenceGuarantee.recoveryMechanism: Automatic failover to SurrealDB on cache miss
